mintAuthority.summary: WEUSD has independent native issuance on BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Plume, and Movement. The PicWe admin EOA is an uncapped EVM native minter/admin across the four EVM deployments, while the Movement package publisher controls the native mint/redeem modules and their undelayed compatible upgrades. PicWe's self-built burn/mint bridge contract, relayer, and bridge-module upgrade surface are assessed separately under bridgeRouteRisk.

sources.label: Movement Aptos REST — WEUSD package registry

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116362149, Base block 50067179, Arbitrum block 495300024, and Plume block 87694882, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) on the local WEUSD token returned true for PicWe admin EOA 0xc12233455beac4e094a5de022be692a264c0c0bc; eth_getCode is empty, confirming an EOA. getRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE) returns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so this EOA can appoint another native minter on each EVM deployment. These are independent native issuance controls; Movement's separate package publisher and the EVM Cross-Chain bridge controls are not included in this Mint Authority control.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD Movement package publisher
controls.evidence: At Movement ledger version 196018785 / block height 85281248, the PicWe account 0xf39c2674014dc3b3af9fd77f31ac69aa9398d8031f2c13a73fccbaca65641ff6 had package picwe at upgrade_number 0 with compatible upgrade policy 1 and an authentication key equal to the publishing account. This is the native Movement mint/redeem authority for weusd_mint_redeem and can publish compatible replacements with no on-chain timelock. The same package contains weusd_cross_chain_gas; that bridge-module upgrade capability is separately represented under Bridge Risk, while this Mint Authority control covers the native mint-critical package path. The EVM WEUSD contracts on BSC, Base, Arbitrum, and Plume have zero EIP-1967 implementation slots and are not proxies.

review.evidence: 2026-08-16 Mint/bridge boundary review: BSC block 116362149, Base block 50067179, Arbitrum block 495300024, and Plume block 87694882 confirm PicWe admin EOA 0xc12233455beac4e094a5de022be692a264c0c0bc as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE holder on the four independent native EVM WEUSD deployments. The previously authored EVM mint/redeem address 0x5D54f1092FD1750A3ab96972dc1867c5B23eF22 has no code and no MINTER_ROLE on those deployments and is removed; the live Cross-Chain contract 0x4b3495391ebb170af31185aed7bb4dfa903ed1fd is bridge machinery and is authored only under bridgeRouteRisk. Movement ledger version 196018785 / block height 85281248 confirms the PicWe package at upgrade_number 0 with compatible upgrade policy 1: its publisher controls native weusd_mint_redeem mint-critical logic with no on-chain timelock. The Movement cross_mint_role_contract relayer 0x86e5136fa2a1416717ff8a08e6d6d31ff9e2f0b1bff6ee8ceefeaed8c5fce8a3 is bridge-only and is authored under bridgeRouteRisk, as is the publisher's bridge-module upgrade capability. All tracked native issuance surfaces are resolved; no multisig or timelock was found. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer EOAs and an undelayed Movement upgrade path permit unbounded minting, while conflicting multi-chain reserve data has no whole-supply attestation and no prudential supervisor. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: PicWe's current documentation still makes only a generic on-chain and real-time auditability claim and publishes no inventory or report reconciling all native EVM and Movement mint paths; reconciliation remains unknown. Codex wave 1 review 2026-08-15: PicWe's Mint & Redeem page describes USDC being locked in the mint contract against equal WEUSD issuance, but publishes no dated recurring reconciliation or live supply-wide reserve feed covering the native EVM and Movement minters; reconciliation remains unknown.
